title: Recorded settings outrank remembered settings
summary: Airframe separates values written into the selected log header from an associated imported configuration, and labels fallback or mismatch instead of quietly blending them.

blocks.text: A Blackbox header is evidence from the selected recording. An imported configuration can fill some presentation gaps, but it may be older, newer, incomplete, or simply from another moment. Airframe marks older fallback and mismatch conditions where those distinctions matter.

items: Prefer the selected segment's header for PID, filter, motor, receiver, and logging facts.
Use Configuration detail to inspect separately captured settings and their provenance.
Do not treat a displayed overlay as proof that a filter behaved perfectly; it shows the configured boundary, not the complete physical result.
